papers.title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
papers.brief: 提出统一电脑操作接口HCU，让智能体按任务组合代码与命令行、无障碍语义和图形界面。通过精简观察、批量操作与状态差分减少交互，并防止通道切换后的过期状态操作。
papers.tldr: 统一代码、语义与视觉操作通道，让智能体更高效可靠地完成电脑任务。
papers.what_it_is: 提出统一电脑操作接口HCU，让智能体按任务组合代码与命令行、无障碍语义和图形界面。通过精简观察、批量操作与状态差分减少交互，并防止通道切换后的过期状态操作。
key_points: HCU统一程序化、AX语义和GUI视觉三通道
AX工具支持精简观察、批量动作与AX diffs
OSWorld 2.0两项评分均居对比系统首位
papers.why_notable: 将电脑操作从模拟鼠标键盘扩展为灵活的多通道协作；所有受测模型均获提升，说明接口设计本身能同时改善任务成功率与效率。
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified interface effectively. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. On OSWorld 2.0, HCU achieves the highest Partial and Binary scores among the compared systems. Analyzing agent trajectories, we find that all evaluated models improve with HCU yet allocate work across the channels differently and consistently outperform compared baselines in terms of both efficiency and task success, highlighting the value of unified computer-use interfaces that allow flexible channel selection and combination.

papers.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
papers.brief: EmoReward先从情绪提示规划评估线索，再融合多类视觉信号。它以样本级门控调整奖励，并从已完成训练的轨迹估计信号可靠性，校准下一轮训练权重。
papers.tldr: 通过训练轨迹自校准情绪奖励权重，让视频生成强化学习更贴合情感意图。
papers.what_it_is: EmoReward先从情绪提示规划评估线索，再融合多类视觉信号。它以样本级门控调整奖励，并从已完成训练的轨迹估计信号可靠性，校准下一轮训练权重。
key_points: Reflective Reward Gating按阶段、置信度等门控
RewardMemory跨训练轮校准权重，不更新奖励模型
在HunyuanVideo 1.5验证，迁移至SD 3.5和FLUX
papers.why_notable: 将情绪评估从固定奖励融合转向基于训练证据的可靠性校准，为主观视觉目标提供更灵活的强化学习反馈机制。
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. EmoReward first plans specific grounding cues from the emotional prompt to guide evaluation, then uses heterogeneous signal primitives to score the generated video during the act stage. Reflective Reward Gating calibrates their contributions through instance-level gates for phase, face confidence, conflict, and subtlety, then renormalizes weights over the active set to produce the sample's fused reward. RewardMemory then estimates each primitive's reliability from rollout scores and outcomes within each emotional regime in the finished training run, then fixes bounded multipliers that calibrate fusion weights in the next training run without updating reward models. Experiments on HunyuanVideo 1.5 show improvements across multiple RL algorithms and compare EmoReward with other agentic reward methods under SAGE-GRPO. Ablations and transfer experiments on SD 3.5 and FLUX further support adaptive reward calibration for visual generation.

papers.title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
papers.brief: 智能体依据数据请求和一次实机校准，在仿真中编写场景、专家控制器与成功判据，再用真实图像条件视频模型生成同步多视角示范，经独立评审后用于策略训练。
papers.tldr: 编码智能体接管示范采集流程，以低成本合成数据训练可直接部署的机器人策略。
papers.what_it_is: 智能体依据数据请求和一次实机校准，在仿真中编写场景、专家控制器与成功判据，再用真实图像条件视频模型生成同步多视角示范，经独立评审后用于策略训练。
key_points: 仿真提供精确动作，视频模型联合生成一致多视角画面
五项实机任务：合成与遥操作数据训练成功数为93比84
新桌布与彩光下成功数87比46；每条新增示范约0.80美元
papers.why_notable: 将任务适配与示范扩增自动化，减少对实机和人工的依赖；实机结果显示，合成数据不仅可用，还可能提升视觉变化下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract: Teleoperation remains the default way to collect robot demonstrations, but every episode costs robot and operator time, and every new task starts from scratch. We ask whether a coding agent can take over the teleoperator's job. In our DataFarm, the agent receives a data request and one calibration episode of the robot in the target scene and rebuilds the task in simulation: it writes the scene, an expert controller, and a success judge. The simulator supplies exact actions, and a video model conditioned on real images renders each rollout as photographic video, generating all camera views together consistently. The output is real-ready data: synchronized camera views labelled with the robot's actions, on which a policy can be trained directly and deployed on the real robot. Independent judges certify the expert and every rendered episode before admission. On five real-robot tasks, policies trained only on farm data match policies trained on as many teleoperated episodes (93 vs. 84 successes in 100 trials), and under an unseen tablecloth and coloured light they keep 87 successes where the teleoperation-trained policies fall to 46. Adapting a task is fully automatic and costs \$21 of API usage on average, paid once per task, plus \$5 for a render contract; every further episode costs \$0.80 on average for simulation, rendering, and review, with no robot or operator. One hour of three-view data for a task costs \$107 on average, these costs included, slightly below a quote of \$117 for teleoperation in China and below \$290 in labour alone in North America.

papers.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
papers.brief: 研究用采样广度与交互深度联合评估多轮强化学习，区分单步决策与长程纠错收益，并提出训练时变化交互预算的BudgetMix RL。
papers.tldr: 多轮强化学习主要增强智能体纠错韧性，混合轮次预算训练可缓解部署性能波动。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用采样广度与交互深度联合评估多轮强化学习，区分单步决策与长程纠错收益，并提出训练时变化交互预算的BudgetMix RL。
key_points: Pass@(K,T)联合衡量采样广度与交互深度
轨迹级RL收益随轮次预算收紧显著减弱
BudgetMix RL混合交互预算，增强跨设置稳健性
papers.why_notable: 将智能体强化学习的收益从单步能力提升转向长程纠错解释，揭示部署预算的重要性，并给出增强预算适应性的训练方案。
papers.abstract: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
papers.organization: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation

papers.title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
papers.brief: 研究用Qwen3检验单教师与多教师策略内蒸馏在强化学习后能力整合中的泛化局限。通过外推和组合任务评测、更新几何分析，并提出几何修补与基座保留回放。
papers.tldr: 策略内蒸馏虽能接近教师的分布内表现，却可能遗忘分布外能力并丢失组合泛化。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用Qwen3检验单教师与多教师策略内蒸馏在强化学习后能力整合中的泛化局限。通过外推和组合任务评测、更新几何分析，并提出几何修补与基座保留回放。
key_points: OPD/MOPD外推OOD得分低于基座2.45–16.25%
MOPD组合OOD得分低于最佳教师18.19–24.34%
联合改善教师能力与数据覆盖，在实验中消除OOD遗忘
papers.why_notable: 揭示分布内蒸馏成功不等于能力完整迁移，并将泛化缺口关联到教师能力、数据覆盖与更新结构，为保留基座能力提供改进方向。
papers.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-distribution (IND) distillation performance, we find that this can mask incomplete capability consolidation beyond the supervised distribution. A preliminary study on synthetic reasoning shows that OPD does not fully transfer teachers' generalization capabilities. We then extend this investigation to real-world tasks, evaluating extrapolative and compositional generalization across mathematical reasoning, coding, agent, and long-context capabilities using Qwen3 models. Across extrapolative settings, OPD and MOPD reach 96.04-102.73% of their teachers' IND scores. Yet their out-of-distribution (OOD) scores remain 2.45-16.25% below the base model's. Across three compositional settings, MOPD improves IND performance over the base model, but its performance on composed tasks as OOD remains 18.19-24.34% below that of the best teachers. To understand these gaps, we examine teacher capability and data coverage as two potential bottlenecks. Jointly alleviating these bottlenecks eliminates OOD forgetting in our experiments and suggests the potential for generalization beyond the teacher. (M)OPD also reduces OOD forgetting on average relative to its reinforcement learning (RL) baselines. Analysis of the associated update geometry reveals smaller and more spectrally concentrated updates on average than those of the RL baselines, along with greater shared update structure under MOPD. Motivated by these findings, we propose geometry-based patching and base-preserving replay to improve OOD performance while largely preserving IND performance. Our findings identify a blind spot in capability consolidation via (M)OPD, highlighting the need for algorithms that explicitly support OOD retention and generalization.

papers.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
papers.brief: TAC-CoT用紧凑潜在片段替代显式推理过程，仅为工具调用、观测和最终答案保留文本令牌，通过交错设计支持隐式推理中的工具交互。
papers.tldr: 以潜在推理片段交错工具交互文本，兼顾智能体推理精度与生成效率。
papers.what_it_is: TAC-CoT用紧凑潜在片段替代显式推理过程，仅为工具调用、观测和最终答案保留文本令牌，通过交错设计支持隐式推理中的工具交互。
key_points: TAC-CoT交错潜在推理片段与显式交互令牌
数学与问答基准准确率最高提升8.8个百分点
模型前向计算次数最多减少至约1/6.8
papers.why_notable: 将隐式推理的计算节省与工具接口的显式通信结合，在提升准确率的同时减少计算，并改善单工具和多工具场景的使用质量。
papers.abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.

papers.title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
papers.brief: 框架改造 Cosmos 世界基础模型，根据动作和场景控制流式生成视觉观测。既能预测动作后果，也能将外部物理仿真器维护的状态转化为画面。
papers.tldr: 将世界模型接入动作与场景控制，为具身智能提供实时交互式视觉仿真。
papers.what_it_is: 框架改造 Cosmos 世界基础模型，根据动作和场景控制流式生成视觉观测。既能预测动作后果，也能将外部物理仿真器维护的状态转化为画面。
key_points: Cosmos 支持动作与场景控制驱动的流式观测
支持动作后果预测和外部物理状态条件生成
演示机器人操作、视频迁移及多视角自动驾驶仿真
papers.why_notable: 将视觉世界模型与物理仿真连接，为具身智能训练和评估提供统一交互环境；代码与模型权重开放，便于复用。
papers.abstract: We present a shared framework that adapts Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive world simulation in Physical AI. By streaming visual observations in response to actions and scene controls, the framework enables users and embodied agents to interact with evolving virtual environments. It supports both predicting the visual consequences of actions and generating observations from physical state maintained by an external simulator. We demonstrate this approach across camera navigation and robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation. These examples provide a shared foundation for developing interactive virtual environments for Physical AI training and evaluation. Our code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos-simulation.

papers.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
papers.brief: SleuthVLM为视觉语言模型配备智能体框架，将语音转成文本而不直接输入音频。模型无需预设工作流，自主探索视频并回答跨模态问题。
papers.tldr: 以语音转写和自主视频探索替代直接听音频，智能体取得更高视频问答准确率。
papers.what_it_is: SleuthVLM为视觉语言模型配备智能体框架，将语音转成文本而不直接输入音频。模型无需预设工作流，自主探索视频并回答跨模态问题。
key_points: 四个全模态基准平均准确率75.0%，超Gemini 3.8 Flash 2.6个百分点
Video-MME-v2准确率77.8%，位居榜首
采用开源27B视觉语言模型，超过所有开源全模态模型
papers.why_notable: 结果表明，直接处理音频未必是视频理解的关键；增强自主探索与推理能力，可能比单纯扩大模型和模态对齐数据更有效。
papers.abstract: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. On four omni benchmarks with videos up to 90 minutes, SleuthVLM achieves the best average accuracy: \textbf{75.0%}, 2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it also tops the Video-MME-v2 leaderboard with \textbf{77.8%}; with an open-source 27B VLM, it beats all open-source omni models. We draw three findings: SleuthVLM beats a model that glances; hearing is not the bottleneck, agentic ability is; omni understanding needs better agentic ability, not just more omni data for modality alignment. So we provide a simple but effective starting point for doing omni video understanding. Omni understanding needs better agents, not just bigger models that hear.

papers.title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
papers.brief: ServerBench让编码智能体通过实验设计完整的专用模型服务系统，以满足延迟要求的令牌价值与GPU成本之比为目标，并用有状态回放和独立验证检查交付结果。
papers.tldr: 用统一成本收益指标评测编码智能体，检验其设计并交付专用模型服务系统的能力。
papers.what_it_is: ServerBench让编码智能体通过实验设计完整的专用模型服务系统，以满足延迟要求的令牌价值与GPU成本之比为目标，并用有状态回放和独立验证检查交付结果。
key_points: 评测11种编码智能体模型、3种部署，共33次运行
Sonnet 5.5在Gemma E4B上达2.97，为vLLM的4.87倍
33次运行中22次通过独立验证，13次超过最强基线
papers.why_notable: 把智能体评测从代码生成推进到可验证的系统交付，并揭示服务收益提升依赖容量优化与负载选择的协同，而非单项性能优化。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.

papers.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
papers.brief: Coca-Cola将工具观察压缩为连续潜在令牌，直接嵌入智能体输入空间；通过动作保持训练，对齐完整与压缩观察下的下一步动作分布。
papers.tldr: 将工具输出压缩为保留决策信息的潜在令牌，让智能体更省上下文且表现更好。
papers.what_it_is: Coca-Cola将工具观察压缩为连续潜在令牌，直接嵌入智能体输入空间；通过动作保持训练，对齐完整与压缩观察下的下一步动作分布。
key_points: Action-Preserving Training对齐下一步动作分布
网页搜索实验覆盖4个问答基准、2个模型家族
令牌消耗降低70.01%–89.24%，任务表现提升
papers.why_notable: 它突破了文本剪枝与摘要的离散表示限制，按决策需求保留信息；端到端耗时降低24.45%–55.97%，显示出实际效率收益。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios. In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embedding space of the agent. We further introduce Action-Preserving Training, which aligns the agent's next-action distributions under full and compressed observations. This trains the compression model to learn action-sufficient latent tokens that retain decision-critical information. Experiments with web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families show that Coca-Cola reduces the agent's token consumption by 70.01%-89.24% and end-to-end runtime by 24.45%-55.97%, while consistently improving task performance. These results suggest that Coca-Cola offers a promising approach for context compression in agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/Coca-cola.

papers.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
papers.brief: TurnWise将GRPO的学习信号从整段轨迹细化到每轮决策，通过静默补全前缀评分分配信用，并按轮平均策略损失，减少历史奖惩和输出长度的干扰。
papers.tldr: 将流式视频强化学习的信用分配细化到轮次，改善回应与等待决策。
papers.what_it_is: TurnWise将GRPO的学习信号从整段轨迹细化到每轮决策，通过静默补全前缀评分分配信用，并按轮平均策略损失，减少历史奖惩和输出长度的干扰。
key_points: 静默补全前缀评分：用剩余回报构造轮级相对优势
轮均策略优化：先轮内再轮间平均词元损失
无需学习型价值评估器或额外采样，实验优于既有RL方法
papers.why_notable: 它把优化重点从奖励设计转向信用分配，针对多轮视频交互中的冗余回应与后续决策受历史奖惩干扰问题，提供了低额外成本的改进路径。
papers.abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.

papers.title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
papers.brief: 研究独立开发的大模型智能体如何在测试时直接协作，用通用框架和极简环境隔离协调难点，并提出可自动发现的协调友好定义（CFDs）。
papers.tldr: 前沿大模型智能体仍难以零样本协作，协调友好定义为改善配合提供新路径。
papers.what_it_is: 研究独立开发的大模型智能体如何在测试时直接协作，用通用框架和极简环境隔离协调难点，并提出可自动发现的协调友好定义（CFDs）。
key_points: 用通用框架与极简环境评估零样本协调
前沿LLM对协调问题及伙伴信念推理不足
提出CFDs支持稳健协调，并可自动发现
papers.why_notable: 将协作失败定位到问题理解与伙伴信念推理，而非复杂环境干扰；为独立开发智能体的互操作提供无需手工设计的改进方向。
papers.abstract: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents.

papers.title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
papers.brief: 研究用带真实权限账本的合成工具任务，审计智能体交接摘要中的虚构限制与授权；再以同快照重放替换可疑句子，检验其对后继智能体行为的影响。
papers.tldr: 智能体自写交接摘要可能虚构权限规则，明确规则来源可减少无依据限制。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用带真实权限账本的合成工具任务，审计智能体交接摘要中的虚构限制与授权；再以同快照重放替换可疑句子，检验其对后继智能体行为的影响。
key_points: 两模型摘要中，无依据限制占1.2%和2.4%
事后重放中，中和虚假授权使越权次数从24降至7
明确规则来源使留出集虚构限制率从1.8%降至0.3%
papers.why_notable: 揭示上下文压缩可能把智能体推测变成权限规则，并给出低成本提示修复；但行为影响证据主要来自事后分析，限制效应尚不稳健。
papers.abstract: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

papers.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.brief: NEO-VLA以轻量图块卷积替代独立视觉编码器，让图像与语言在主干中共同演化；流匹配动作专家从不同深度读取指令条件化视觉表征。
papers.tldr: 让动作策略直接读取多层视觉计算，比依赖固定编码器输出更稳健。
papers.what_it_is: NEO-VLA以轻量图块卷积替代独立视觉编码器，让图像与语言在主干中共同演化；流匹配动作专家从不同深度读取指令条件化视觉表征。
key_points: 轻量图块卷积将图像转换为词元，不设独立视觉编码器
流匹配动作专家利用不同深度的指令条件化视觉表征
逐层探测发现，动作关键信号常在最终视觉层之前达峰
papers.why_notable: 受控比较显示，完整微调与扩大规模仍无法抹平架构差距；结果支持跨层视觉访问作为提升操控性能与分布外鲁棒性的方向。
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.

papers.title: VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation
papers.brief: 提出速度对抗蒸馏，用学习式判别器比较师生速度场并反馈训练；进一步沿学生去噪轨迹匹配分布，结合转移感知在线速度学习与双形式监督。
papers.tldr: 通过速度场对抗蒸馏改善少步生成，实现图像与视频四步采样的领先质量。
papers.what_it_is: 提出速度对抗蒸馏，用学习式判别器比较师生速度场并反馈训练；进一步沿学生去噪轨迹匹配分布，结合转移感知在线速度学习与双形式监督。
key_points: VAD统一分数蒸馏、Fisher匹配与矩匹配
VA-TDM对学生轨迹中的部分去噪进行监督
图像与视频四步生成领先，可扩展至33B H3
papers.why_notable: 为少步蒸馏中学生分布估计失配提供统一改进路径；人类偏好评测显示，其H3版本优于Fast-H3，更接近原始多步模型。
papers.abstract: Few-step distillation offers efficient generation with diffusion and flow models, but preserving quality with only a few sampling steps remains challenging. Distribution-matching methods via score distillation provide a strong foundation, yet they rely on accurately tracking the student's changing distribution. At intermediate generation steps in few-step sampling, student-score estimation can be difficult, and commonly used estimators may describe a different distribution from the one used to update the student. Flow matching allows a more flexible approach to supervision through velocity fields constructed from the student's sampling process. Building on this perspective, we introduce Velocity Adversarial Distillation (VAD), which uses a learned critic to compare student and teacher fields and turn their disagreement into feedback for learning. VAD unifies score distillation, Fisher-based matching, and moment matching, also explaining existing heuristic MMD updates and delivering new training objectives. We further develop VA-TDM, which follows trajectory distribution matching: providing supervision for partial denoising along the student trajectory. Beyond this, VA-TDM combines transition-aware online velocity learning and dual-form VAD supervision across intermediate student transitions. Extensive results show that VA-TDM is powerful for learning few-step generators, achieving state-of-the-art four-step performance in both text-to-image and text-to-video generation across various backbones and scaling effectively to 33B MiniMax-H3. In particular, our VA-TDM-H3 notably outperforms the few-step Fast-H3 and is closer to the original many-step H3 according to human preference.

papers.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
papers.brief: 提出覆盖九个物理领域的端到端科研基准，要求智能体完成文献调研、研究规划、实验与论文写作，并结合确定性验证器和专家量规评估正确性与可发表性。
papers.tldr: 端到端物理科研评测揭示，前沿智能体仍受推理严谨性与专家直觉不足制约。
papers.what_it_is: 提出覆盖九个物理领域的端到端科研基准，要求智能体完成文献调研、研究规划、实验与论文写作，并结合确定性验证器和专家量规评估正确性与可发表性。
key_points: 42位物理学家基于自身研究设计56项任务
确定性验证器与专家量规联合评估科研质量
22个模型、26种配置中，最佳仅通过46/168次运行
papers.why_notable: 将评测从解题推进到完整科研流程，同时检验正确性与可发表性；轨迹分析提示，主要瓶颈是推理与专家直觉，而非知识或执行。
papers.abstract: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.

papers.title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
papers.brief: H2RB用非配对的人类与机器人示范联合训练预训练VLA，通过几何锚定对齐观测表征，并用解耦解码器共享动作潜变量，保留不同具身的动作映射。
papers.tldr: H2RB打通人机表征与动作空间，让人类示范有效适配预训练机器人策略。
papers.what_it_is: H2RB用非配对的人类与机器人示范联合训练预训练VLA，通过几何锚定对齐观测表征，并用解耦解码器共享动作潜变量，保留不同具身的动作映射。
key_points: 几何锚定对齐表征，解耦解码器共享动作潜变量
真实任务物体迁移评分从8.0升至51.8
技能迁移达62.7；分布外迁移从6.0升至45.3
papers.why_notable: 它让易采集的人类示范成为机器人策略的有效监督，在真实任务与物体位置变化下均提升迁移表现，有望降低目标机器人示范采集成本。
papers.abstract: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies provide a strong starting point for deployment, but adapting them to a target robot and environment still requires costly embodiment-specific demonstrations. Human demonstrations are far easier to collect, yet directly leveraging them is challenging due to the substantial human-robot embodiment gap, particularly when the underlying VLA has been pretrained primarily on robot data. We introduce H2RB (Human-To-Robot Bridge), a human-robot co-training framework for adapting pretrained VLA policies from unpaired human and robot demonstrations. H2RB bridges the embodiment gap at both interfaces: geometry-anchored alignment grounds human and robot observations in a compatible representation, while a decoupled-decoder tokenizer shares action latents without forcing both domains through a single action mapping. This design allows human demonstrations to provide useful behavioral supervision while retaining the rich visual, semantic, and control priors of the pretrained VLA. Across real-world tasks, H2RB substantially improves object transfer performance from 8.0 to 51.8 and enables skill transfer to score 62.7, in settings where co-train baselines totally fail to transfer human-demonstrated skills. The benefit also persists under object-placement shifts, improving out-of-distribution transfer from 6.0 to 45.3. H2RB suggests a way for human demonstrations to serve as a scalable supervision source for adapting pretrained robotic policies, reducing the dependence on costly target-robot data collection.

papers.title: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.brief: 提出文本流对抗蒸馏，将联合注意力后的中间文本状态用于判别，并通过字体、物体或风格等条件线索，引导判别器关注不同图像属性。
papers.tldr: 利用多模态扩散模型的文本流做对抗蒸馏，将高质量图像生成压缩至一至两步。
papers.what_it_is: 提出文本流对抗蒸馏，将联合注意力后的中间文本状态用于判别，并通过字体、物体或风格等条件线索，引导判别器关注不同图像属性。
key_points: TSAD以中间文本词元状态作为对抗表征
ACD用字体、物体或风格线索控制判别重点
结合专家判别器，将4—8步蒸馏降至1—2步
papers.why_notable: 把文本流从条件输入变为可操控的判别表征，在相近质量下减少生成步数，并改善单步生成的文字清晰度与细节。
papers.abstract: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention. We introduce Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD), which exploits intermediate text-token states as a new adversarial representation. Because the text stream has already read the image while remaining tied to the text condition, changing that condition changes what information it extracts from the image. Building on this property, we introduce Aspect-Cued Discrimination (ACD), which conditions the discriminator on different aspects of the sample, such as typography, objects, or style, to steer which properties are emphasized during adversarial training. Building on the expert-discriminator design of NitroFusion, we integrate TSAD and ACD in NitroFusion2. NitroFusion2 brings few-step distillation from the conventional 4-8-step regime down to just 1-2 steps at comparable quality. At one step, it produces sharp rendered text and rich fine-grained details, making one-step generation practical rather than merely a stress test for distillation. At two steps, it remains competitive across the evaluated benchmarks. These results establish the MMDiT text stream as a powerful and steerable representation for adversarial diffusion distillation.

papers.title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
papers.brief: KGO将概率预测建模为结构化不确定性的演化，用Koopman潜空间外推轨迹并通过矩阵指数单步生成，再按变量和预测跨度自适应调节不确定性。
papers.tldr: 借助潜空间动力学与单步生成，兼顾概率时序预测精度和推理效率。
papers.what_it_is: KGO将概率预测建模为结构化不确定性的演化，用Koopman潜空间外推轨迹并通过矩阵指数单步生成，再按变量和预测跨度自适应调节不确定性。
key_points: KoPE外推时序潜轨迹，AUG按变量与跨度调节不确定性
KoFM以闭式矩阵指数单步生成，推理至少提速25倍
17项ProbTS基准中，CRPS领先13项、NMAE领先16项
papers.why_notable: 它将时序动力学结构与灵活生成结合，在多项基准上同时提升精度和效率，为低延迟概率预测提供了有竞争力的方案。
papers.abstract: Probabilistic time-series forecasting requires models that simultaneously capture structured temporal dynamics, expressive uncertainty, and efficient inference, yet existing approaches fall short of this goal: latent dynamical models impose structure but rely on restrictive generation mechanisms, while modern generative methods such as diffusion and flow matching achieve flexibility at the cost of iterative and computationally expensive sampling. We introduce the Koopman Generative Operator (KGO), a probabilistic forecasting method that conceptualizes prediction as the evolution of structured uncertainty. KGO integrates three core components: (1) Koopman Patch Embedding (KoPE) for temporally consistent latent trajectory extrapolation; (2) Koopman Flow Matching (KoFM), which enables fast, single-step generation through a closed-form matrix exponential in a Koopman latent space, bypassing iterative sampling; and (3) an Adaptive Uncertainty Gate (AUG), which provides probabilistic forecasts by adapting uncertainty per-variable and per-horizon, corresponding to a learned decomposition of aleatoric uncertainty without manual tuning. By unifying these components, KGO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on 13/17 ProbTS benchmarks in CRPS and 16/17 in NMAE. Further, by eliminating iterative sampling, KGO delivers at least a 25$\times$ reduction in inference time compared to iterative generative models. These results position KGO as a practical and principled framework that advances the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in probabilistic time-series forecasting, combining leading accuracy on the evaluated benchmarks with fast, single-step generation.

papers.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.brief: LoopVQ针对循环模型缓存冗余，联合编码多个循环步骤的通道，并微调码本对齐全精度输出；利用步骤间量化敏感度差异实现极低比特压缩。
papers.tldr: 联合量化跨循环键值缓存，以低于一比特精度缓解显存瓶颈并加速推理。
papers.what_it_is: LoopVQ针对循环模型缓存冗余，联合编码多个循环步骤的通道，并微调码本对齐全精度输出；利用步骤间量化敏感度差异实现极低比特压缩。
key_points: 0.5比特下，在Ouro和Huginn多类任务上优于现有方法
结合TaSQ，0.25比特仍保留大部分BF16精度
SGLang中32K解码延迟近减半，吞吐最高提升6.1倍
papers.why_notable: 它补齐循环模型参数省而缓存不省的短板，并将极低比特压缩转化为实际服务加速，对长上下文推理尤其有价值。
papers.abstract: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

papers.title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.

papers.title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
papers.abstract: In this work, we evaluate a simple inference-time scaling approach based on \textit{turn-level best-of-N sampling} (\method) for large language model (LLM) agents on complex, long-horizon tasks. We instantiate this using a \textit{generator-selector} framework with two LLMs; at each turn, a \emph{generator} model generates $N$ candidate actions and a \emph{selector} model selects one of them, which is then executed in the environment. This paper is closely related to the work of \cite{zainullina2025guided} who used critic models for guided search at inference time. Different from their work, we evaluate if off-the-shelf, open-weight LLMs can be effective at comparing different candidate actions directly. Experiments on long-horizon terminal tasks show that \method can lead to significant performance improvements, both in terms of accuracy (5--10\%) and consistency across repeated attempts. Analysis of agent trajectories reveal a shift in agent behaviour towards desirable patterns such as reduction in number of attempts to solve the task, improved task instruction following, debugging and testing.
selected_reasons: 与 computer use / agent 相关

papers.title: Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
papers.abstract: Efficient benchmarking estimates a system's full benchmark performance from a small number of task executions. Standard approaches rely solely on the binary correctness of executions from a collection of already-evaluated reference systems. An agentic system, however, produces a rich trace for each execution that can reveal substantially more about its capabilities. Leveraging this information requires useful trace representations. We propose representing a trace by extracting a structured summary of it with an LLM and embedding the summary with a standard text encoder. These representations preserve correctness- and task-related signal while minimizing the presence of system identity-, model family- and harness-related signals that dominate raw trace embeddings. Given this representation for each task execution from all reference systems, we construct low-dimensional representations of the systems and predict a new system's score from its position among the reference systems. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0, augmenting an item-response model with this geometry-based prediction reduces mean absolute error from 0.13 to 0.08 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-4}$) and from 0.14 to 0.12 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-3}$), respectively, when provided a single random executed task. Further, given access to the full set of reference systems, our approach dominates baselines for any given number of executed tasks on both benchmarks.
selected_reasons: 与 computer use / agent 相关

papers.title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
papers.abstract: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over 1.7 trillion US dollars in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025) and the Multinational Time Use Study (Fisher et al., 2025). For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context. Task creators had to pass our expertise threshold (including personally completing the task multiple times and seeing the results through in their real lives for over a year) and also write a rubric, ensuring that our evaluation measured the best personalized completion for that task. All tasks had to pass at least three rounds of human quality-control before acceptance into our final evaluation sets.

papers.title: AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Infrastructure security does not establish whether an LLM agent selected an allowed tool, grounded its answer in tool output, or followed a required workflow. AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that expresses these application-layer expectations as policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces. A deterministic replay implementation supports repeatable build-time tests; a judge interface provides an extension point for optional semantic evaluation. On 55 synthetic cases spanning seven enterprise domains, the full pipeline correctly classifies all 30 injected faults and 25 passing controls, including ten non-trivial controls, and misses none of 12 designated critical cases. Each single-layer configuration correctly classifies 35 cases because the corpus deliberately isolates ten faults per layer. A grounded answer obtained through a disallowed sequence illustrates the additional coverage of trajectory checks. Repeated measurements quantify validator execution separately from process startup and reporting. These results establish coverage of the authored regression suite, not production accuracy. We describe a production-trace validation protocol, optional LLM-judge integration, and maintenance of expectations as workflows evolve. The contribution is a practical pattern for expressing behavioral contracts within an existing Java release pipeline.

papers.title: RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
papers.abstract: Resource management for distributed edge networks hosting different services has been handled efficiently using Reinforcement learning (RL). Reward generalization in complex workflows is still an open issue within the RL realm. Therefore, this work proposes RAGAM-AI, a hybrid framework that combines the capabilities of RL algorithms and Generative-AI (Gen-AI) for powering an Agentic AI workflow that optimizes resource allocation at the Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) units. This framework further resolves the reward generalization issue by utilizing Large Language Model (LLM) for feedback. A Multi- Agent Soft-Actor Critic (MASAC) using MathΣtral as a reward oracle is implemented for managing resource allocations at the MEC. RAGAM-AI interprets system state information and evaluates multi-objective trade-offs guiding the resource orchestration loop over distributed edge server agents. The complexity of the framework is further brought down by incorporating surrogate reward model. The overall performance is evaluated against the single agent SAC, REINFORCE and random policies for benchmarking. On using RAGAM-AI, lower allocation deviations for CPU, memory and bandwidth resources are reported while minimizing the latency and data rate costs. A scalable AI as a feedback (AIAF) solution optimizing network resources with significant performance improvement is thus presented.

papers.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.

papers.title: EviSeek: An Evidence-Centric Agentic Framework for Embodied Active Information Seeking
papers.abstract: Active embodied question answering requires agents to acquire evidence through viewpoint changes and physical interaction. The central challenge is to avoid undirected interaction: taking plausible actions without specifying what evidence they should reveal for answering the question. Action plans and accumulated histories alone can leave the informational purpose of an interaction implicit. We introduce EviSeek, a training-free framework that makes question-derived evidence demands explicit acquisition objectives, linking observation-conditioned actions and selectively retained evidence to the information the agent seeks. On 3,436 ESI-Bench questions, EviSeek improves accuracy over the Single-model agent by 7.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL-32B and 3.7 points with Gemini 3.1 Pro, while improving visual-support-weighted accuracy and reducing mean token usage. These findings support making the informational purpose of interaction explicit, with action selection and evidence retention organized around what the agent needs to learn to answer the question.

papers.title: MA-Mesh: Resilient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Role-based Self-Healing
papers.abstract: Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires mechanisms for coordination and adaptability in dynamic and uncertain environments. However, existing multi-agent systems rarely model resilience explicitly, instead relying on ad-hoc output correction that limits systematic, runtime management of robustness. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Mesh (MA-Mesh), a framework that constructs a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, MA-Mesh generates resilience-aware system specifications and synthesizes them into executable multi-agent policy code. To enhance resilience, we introduce two self-healing mechanisms: Cross-agent reflection, a mechanism that allows agents to evaluate not only their own outcomes but also the performance of their peers, enabling informed behavioral adjustments and collective policy refinement; Role-based failover, a strategy which dynamically reassigns roles and enables agents to substitute for one another when sub-tasks fail or agents underperform, ensuring continuity of task execution. Experimental results across diverse tasks (e.g., software development, tool use, scientific reasoning) demonstrate that MA-Mesh significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and robustness under system uncertainty.

papers.title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
papers.abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.

papers.title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
papers.abstract: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backward question construction to obscure entity names and image targets that would expose reasoning shortcuts while retaining necessary disambiguating clues, yielding text-only, image-initialized, and arbitrarily interleaved multi-hop problems. We train the ModalSearcher Agent with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment, and construct ModalSearch-Bench. Experiments show that ModalSearcher-8B improves average accuracy by 16.2 points over Qwen3-VL-8B under the same agentic workflow across five multimodal knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, with consistent gains on independently constructed active visual-search benchmarks.

papers.title: Graph-Mediated Large Language Model Systems in the Agentic Era: Reasoning, Knowledge, Retrieval, Execution, and Coordination
papers.abstract: Graphs play an increasingly important role in large language model (LLM) systems, supporting structural reasoning, knowledge grounding, retrieval, and memory. As these systems evolve toward the agentic era, graphs also organize execution dependencies and multi-agent communication, linking intermediate observations and retained information to subsequent decisions. However, understanding their contribution requires distinguishing the function of each graph operation, the component responsible for its computation, and the subsequent use of its output. This survey introduces an operation-level role--locus taxonomy for reasoning, knowledge and evidence, retrieval and memory, execution, and coordination. We compare how graph observations and external computations guide decisions, how memory representations and updates support later tasks, and how dependencies constrain execution and information delivery. These comparisons distinguish improvements in local metrics from downstream task performance while retaining the conditions under which results were reported. We then organize benchmarks, comparison designs, process diagnostics, and system costs into an evaluation framework. Finally, we identify open challenges in adaptive computation and stopping, memory maintenance, and dependency-aware recovery. The survey provides a basis for assessing when graph mechanisms are useful and for evaluating their effects across components and stages.

papers.title: CellCanon: An Agentic Cellular World Model for Prediction, Explanation, and Observation-Driven Updating
papers.abstract: Biological discovery requires using molecular knowledge and new measurements to infer responses beyond the conditions already observed. We introduce CellCanon, the first agentic cellular world model to unify single-cell expression prediction, evidence-grounded explanation, and observation-driven updating. Its predictive core reuses condition-level biological evidence across gene-specific numerical readouts to guide single-cell expression generation. A shared world state links predictions, acquired measurements, and source-linked claims, supporting explanation and revision. On 339 held-out SciPlex3 conditions across three cell lines, CellCanon improves differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 over the best baseline for each metric by 63.3% and 17.3%, respectively, and direction Macro-F1 by 7.2%. Relative to gene-wise reasoning on matched drug-cell cohorts, measured language-model token use falls by 99.77% for Predict and 98.41% for Explain. On the source-grounded benchmark, Explain correctly answers all answerable questions with supporting proofs and identifies all insufficient-evidence cases. In simulated experimental feedback, Update uses one measured source context per drug to exceed the best fine-tuned baselines in differential-expression AUPRC and Macro-F1 without changing model weights. Together, these capabilities support a cumulative account of cellular responses, with predictions and biological judgments that can be revised as evidence accumulates.

papers.title: A Framework for Context Enrichment and Selective Robustness in LLM Social Agents
papers.abstract: Researchers use large language models as agents in social simulations, where agents are prompted with observations and background information intended to shape their actions. Yet LLM agents have been shown to substantially change their behavior under meaning-preserving prompt variations, creating a validation problem for social simulation. One plausible hypothesis is that this brittleness reflects a lack of grounding and can be reduced by enriching the context provided to the agents. Whether richer context improves robustness remains unclear, in part because context richness and robustness are rarely defined in ways that support controlled comparisons. We address the first need with controlled context enrichment, a set of prompt substitution rules that systematically enriches distinct types of context: neutral padding, generic social background, descriptive decision grounding, and normative decision grounding. We address the second by introducing selective robustness as a validation criterion: insensitivity to meaning-preserving prompt variation combined with a directional response to decision-relevant changes in the social world. We demonstrate the framework in a Prisoner's Dilemma-like game, showing how it can be used to identify which forms of context enrichment produce more desirable and robust agent behavior. We find that these forms of enrichment produce distinct behavioral patterns that vary between the two models tested.

papers.title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.

papers.title: Analysis of Local Open-Weight LLM Agents on Vulnerability-Reproduction Tasks
papers.abstract: Open-weight language models that fit on a single consumer GPU are becoming capable on a growing range of tasks, and they matter because they can run locally without sending the code to a hosted service. Vulnerability reproduction, turning a vulnerability description into an input that crashes the vulnerable build, is a natural target for them, since it is an automated analysis task closer to test generation than to code comprehension and it runs against a build that must be executed rather than read. In order to assess whether current models can perform it, we evaluate twelve configurations of local models, spanning three generations, two architectures and three quantization levels, on ten CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, three runs each under one harness, and release the full artefact. We show that every configuration, down to the 4B model, solves most of the six easier tasks, and configurations separate only on the remaining four. For the harder tasks, the 27B model is required. Quantization did not change what the models solved in any matched pair, but it changed how fast they got there, and the mixture of experts reached the same scores in less wall clock. We also examine the agent trajectories. Almost every run we examined, including those that fail, names the vulnerable function and states the correct hypothesis, and what separates a solved task from an unsolved one is whether that hypothesis becomes a working input.

papers.title: Shallow Encoding Emits Deep Memories
papers.abstract: Hybrid language models interleave a few softmax-attention layers with many linear-attention or state-space layers, so every layer keeps a memory of earlier tokens: a key-value cache or a fixed-size recurrent state. Serving them spends more compute and high-bandwidth memory on these memories than the output requires. The prefill runs every layer for every prompt token, and every decode step loads and stores whole recurrent states, which on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next take as many bytes per request as the attention cache of thousands of tokens. We find two properties of trained hybrids that locate this excess. First, writes are easier than reads: writing a deep layer's memory of a token needs little of the deep computation that predicting the next token needs. Trained copies of the deep layers' write paths, which we call emitters, therefore write a prompt's deep memories from the residual stream of a shallower anchor layer, and all prompt tokens but the last run as few as 63% of the layers. Second, recurrent states have a state sink: most of their energy lies in a rank-one term along a fixed direction of each head, and the rest is a low-rank working memory. SEED builds on both: it makes the prefill shallow in depth and the decode state shallow in representation. Each recurrent state is stored as its sink plus low-rank factors, which the Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention and Mamba-2 updates extend exactly; we prove that the open-loop error of the periodic compressions back to low rank is bounded independently of their number. SEED keeps the original weights frozen, compresses no attention cache, and runs all layers for every generated token. On six checkpoints of five production hybrids of 30B to over 300B parameters, it is nearly lossless on eleven official exams. Served with SGLang on NVIDIA GB300 GPUs on an agentic-coding trace, it raises the per-GPU throughput of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 1.2-1.4x.

papers.title: SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification
papers.abstract: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.

papers.title: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can improve decision-making with world-model foresight, provided that predicted states accurately reflect post-action interfaces. Existing state representations fail to jointly capture interface layout, UI semantics, and explicit locations. We introduce Typed Spatial Markdown (TSM), a Markdown-style textual state representation for desktop web interfaces. TSM serializes block-level and atomic-level UI elements according to their spatial relationships, jointly encoding their types, visual semantics, explicit locations, optional control states, and hierarchical membership. To train a screenshot-to-TSM renderer, we construct AtomBlock-WebUI, a dataset with precise annotations at both granularities. By injecting element-type labels into HTML and directly extracting bounding boxes after rendering, we avoid annotation errors caused by post-hoc inference from webpage structures. Building on TSM, we propose MKD2World, a desktop web world model trained in two stages for current-state description and action-conditioned next-state prediction. During inference, the web agent queries MKD2World as needed and performs a ``digest'' step, in which it interprets each predicted state and extracts task-relevant evidence for selecting the best action. Experiments show that MKD2World-9B achieves an EleF1 score of 26.50 on the out-of-domain test set, outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol(14.98) by 11.52 points. Across Online-Mind2Web tasks, MKD2World-9B improves the success rate of the Qwen3.5-35B web agent from 22.94% to 37.61%, achieving competitive performance among leading open-source GUI world models. Code is available at https://github.com/OmniAI-Lab-CUHKSZ/MKD2World.

papers.title: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
papers.brief: Halley为AI数据中心光网络构建预测控制平面，覆盖激光器备用池、交换调度、微环温控和模块保护；依据下一状态提前干预，不确定时回退至现有策略。
papers.tldr: 通过四层预测控制提前应对光网络故障，提高大规模模型训练的有效吞吐与能效。
papers.what_it_is: Halley为AI数据中心光网络构建预测控制平面，覆盖激光器备用池、交换调度、微环温控和模块保护；依据下一状态提前干预，不确定时回退至现有策略。
key_points: LightReserve保证备用覆盖，FoldFit达最优的11/9界
ThermaLead前瞻温控，TriageGuard优先保护高风险模块
组合仿真中有效吞吐占比由65.2%升至76.5%
papers.why_notable: 将相关故障下的资源冗余与预测控制统一起来，各组件具有形式化保证；回退电路经验证并通过130纳米签核，兼顾收益与硬件可实现性。
papers.abstract: A frontier AI model is trained in an AI data center, on tens of thousands of accelerators joined by a dedicated network, and every training step ends with all of them exchanging data at once. Between racks, that network is optical, and each of its four layers, from lasers to switches, runs a fixed or after-the-fact policy. Lasers sharing an enclosure, cooling, and power can fail together. At a fixed spare ratio, correlated failure provably caps a pool's availability however large it grows. In this paper, we present a comprehensive predictive control plane framework, called Halley, that reads each resource's next state and acts before the failure occurs. It has four components, each carrying a formal guarantee: LightReserve that sizes the laser pool to provide a coverage bound, FoldFit that schedules the switch within $11/9$ of the optimal, ThermaLead that holds a microring with one-step-ahead control, and TriageGuard that protects the highest-risk modules first. Halley gives each layer a predictive controller that defers to the deployed policy when unsure. Composed from simulations at that point, effective goodput, the share of ideal throughput kept, rises from 65.2\% to 76.5\% if a window that exhausts its spares is lost. If only the dark channels' bandwidth is lost, it reaches 67.4\%. Per megawatt, that is up to 1.03--1.17 times the training; for the same training, up to 3.3--14.7\% less data center capacity. \textsf{Halley}'s fallback circuits are formally verified and are shown to achieve close timing on a commercial FPGA, and pass a 130~nm signoff.

papers.title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
papers.brief: 提出视频多轮对话基准，以视觉情节依赖和历史回答依赖分别检验模型对所见、所说的记忆。通过三角色大模型构建与人工审核，确保问题必须依赖前文且不泄露答案。
papers.tldr: 用跨轮依赖对话检验多模态模型的视频记忆，最强模型总分仅45.7%。
papers.what_it_is: 提出视频多轮对话基准，以视觉情节依赖和历史回答依赖分别检验模型对所见、所说的记忆。通过三角色大模型构建与人工审核，确保问题必须依赖前文且不泄露答案。
key_points: 326段视频、2476轮对话，1387轮依赖前文
规划、生成、评判三角色流水线验证必要性与非泄漏性
评测超20个模型，Claude Opus 5最高分45.7%
papers.why_notable: 将评测从独立视频问答推进到跨轮信息复用，揭示长视频理解并不等于对话记忆，为多模态模型的记忆能力提供针对性测试。
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.

papers.title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
papers.brief: Muon-RT将EMA教师与学生的参数差作为历史更新信号，去除径向分量并做谱归一化，再与经Newton-Schulz正交化的当前梯度混合。
papers.tldr: 复用教师与学生的参数差替代动量，在大模型自蒸馏中同时节省显存并提升准确率。
papers.what_it_is: Muon-RT将EMA教师与学生的参数差作为历史更新信号，去除径向分量并做谱归一化，再与经Newton-Schulz正交化的当前梯度混合。
key_points: 复用EMA轨迹，取消隐藏权重矩阵的动量缓冲
Qwen2.5-7B上较AdamW准确率增2.6点，持久内存降42%
Olmo-3-7B上SDPO较AdamW准确率增2.0点
papers.why_notable: 将自蒸馏已有的教师历史转化为优化器状态，减少重复存储；在两种训练设置中提升准确率，并在明确假设下给出收敛界。
papers.abstract: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points with 42% less persistent memory, and over momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less persistent memory. With Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, it improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.0 points.

papers.title: VeriSpoof: Beyond Real or Fake with One Audio LLM
papers.brief: VeriSpoof以共享权重统一检测、生成器归因、录音条件分析、伪造片段定位与同源验证。通过句子似然评分及反事实训练，让判断依据可独立核验。
papers.tldr: 用同一音频语言模型统一语音伪造检测与溯源，并以可核验依据支持判断。
papers.what_it_is: VeriSpoof以共享权重统一检测、生成器归因、录音条件分析、伪造片段定位与同源验证。通过句子似然评分及反事实训练，让判断依据可独立核验。
key_points: Plus在14个测试集上EER为2.14%，开放权重系统第一
未见生成器的录音同源验证EER为6.2%
仅更新29.7M参数，梯度检查点支持单卡24GB训练
papers.why_notable: 将真假判别扩展为多任务语音取证，同时提供可核验依据；在PartialEdit上，依据检查将局部伪造识别率从78.4%提升至99.6%。
papers.abstract: A speech deepfake detector estimates whether a recording is synthetic, but a forensic analyst also asks which system produced it, whether recordings share a source, and what evidence supports each conclusion. We present VeriSpoof, an audio language model that unifies five tasks with shared weights: deepfake detection, generator attribution (generator, acoustic model and vocoder), recording-condition analysis, synthesized-span localisation, and source verification. Each decision is supported by grounded rationales whose statements can be independently verified. Answers are scored by sentence likelihood, allowing detection and source verification to be thresholded without separate heads. Rationale statements can be checked against waveform measurements, span labels, or generator metadata. Counterfactual examples train decisions to follow the stated evidence. Across the 14 Speech-DF-Arena test sets, VeriSpoof-Plus achieves 2.14% pooled EER, ranking third of 28 systems and first among open-weight systems. VeriSpoof-Base, trained only on official training splits of eight corpora, achieves 4.43% EER, less than half that of the next open-weight detector. With the same weights, VeriSpoof-Plus verifies whether recordings from generators unseen in training share a source at 6.2% EER. Controlled studies show that the audio representation governs detection, the LLM governs recording comparison, and source supervision is necessary for neural-codec fakes. Statement-checkable rationales catch partial fakes missed by one-step answers (99.6% vs. 78.4% on PartialEdit) and determine decisions under edits unseen in training (99.5%). Training updates only 29.7M of 2.85B parameters, fitting a single 24 GB GPU with gradient checkpointing. We release both models, inference code, a demo, and VeriSpoof-Bench, the evaluation suite covering these questions.

papers.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
papers.brief: 提出模板式多语言数据扩增流程：从有害提示中提取安全模板，翻译后填入文化真实的有害或无害实体，构建拒答与良性语料MSafeTemp。
papers.tldr: 用文化本地化模板扩展六十种语言的安全训练，揭示英语评测遗漏的风险。
papers.what_it_is: 提出模板式多语言数据扩增流程：从有害提示中提取安全模板，翻译后填入文化真实的有害或无害实体，构建拒答与良性语料MSafeTemp。
key_points: MSafeTemp提供经验证的60种语言安全语料
模板翻译后填槽，生成文化本地化有害与良性样本
模板增强训练改善英语之外的安全表现
papers.why_notable: 说明仅用英语评测会误判模型安全性，文化本地化还能发现直接翻译遗漏的漏洞，为低资源语言安全对齐提供可扩展的数据路径。
papers.abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.

papers.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
papers.brief: D3D以分块去噪结合辅助自回归监督，训练不依赖目标模型隐藏状态的扩散草稿器。验证期间即可打包起草后续块，实现异步推测解码。
papers.tldr: 独立扩散草稿模型打破轮间依赖，让起草与验证异步并行，加速大模型解码。
papers.what_it_is: D3D以分块去噪结合辅助自回归监督，训练不依赖目标模型隐藏状态的扩散草稿器。验证期间即可打包起草后续块，实现异步推测解码。
key_points: 分块去噪与辅助自回归监督提升已接受前缀长度
36层剪去5层，三项基准保留超99%平均接受长度
七项基准平均加速5.00倍与5.71倍，优于DFlash
papers.why_notable: 关键突破是解除草稿器对目标隐藏状态的依赖，让起草与验证真正重叠；在两种目标模型规模上均取得更高平均加速。
papers.abstract: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. D3D combines blockwise denoising with auxiliary autoregressive supervision to achieve long accepted prefixes without target hidden states. This independence lets D3D draft successor blocks during verification in one packed pass, enabling asynchronous speculative decoding. We progressively prune layers according to their effect on acceptance length to reduce the cost of packed drafting. Removing five of 36 layers retains over 99\% of mean acceptance length across three benchmarks with Qwen3-8B as the target. Across seven benchmarks, D3D averages 5.00$\times$ and 5.71$\times$ decoding speedup with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B targets, compared with 4.03$\times$ and 3.67$\times$ for DFlash. On GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, speedup reaches 7.48$\times$. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/fudan-generative-vision/D3D.

papers.title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
papers.brief: PyRUA-REAL让编码智能体通过真实机器人探索与执行反馈迭代代码，将经验保存为持久记忆和可复用技能，并支持无需在线智能体决策的程序部署。
papers.tldr: 通过真实交互积累记忆与可执行技能，让机器人持续改进并脱离在线智能体部署。
papers.what_it_is: PyRUA-REAL让编码智能体通过真实机器人探索与执行反馈迭代代码，将经验保存为持久记忆和可复用技能，并支持无需在线智能体决策的程序部署。
key_points: 具身递归自改进（RSI）结合探索、代码修订与技能复用
8项真实世界任务平均成功率91.1%
RoboDojo的42项任务平均成功率84.4%
papers.why_notable: 将物理交互经验转化为可持续积累的机器人技能，并验证脱离在线智能体的部署方式，为兼顾能力提升与执行效率提供实证。
